versions.changelog:
comfyui-client v1.2.0 introduces detailed documentation and expanded workflows for advanced ComfyUI automation.

- Added comprehensive SKILL.md describing usage scenarios, capabilities (txt2img, img2img, video), and command-line options.
- Included workflow selection guidance for different image/video generation tasks.
- Documented bundled workflows (Z-Image, Qwen edit, Wan2 video) with relative paths for out-of-the-box use.
- Clarified required environment, triggers, output structure, and workflow node IDs for prompt/image editing.
- Provided complete usage examples for both command-line and script/module calls.
